pixel.tap.title: Send a crate!
pixel.tap.body: Tap the front crate of a lane. It hops into the tray, and the Parcel Pals pack every matching block they can reach. Press and hold a crate to peek at what it would pack.

twist.stone.title: Crumbly stones
twist.stone.body: Gray stones block the way and never get packed. They crumble as soon as a block next to them is packed, which opens the path behind them.

pixel.jam.title: The Pals are jammed
pixel.jam.body: Every tray slot is full of crates waiting for blocks that are still buried. Undo a few crates, then send the crates that clear the outside first. Keep a slot free for the crates that need to wait.
